QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_67

question.text: Exposure limits for clearing members are checked against:

answer.text: Their available capital including deposits and collateral — additional exposure requires additional capital/deposit
The number of clients they serve

explanation.text: The Logic: Exchanges and SEBI stipulate capital-adequacy and net-worth requirements for clearing members. Deposits act as a line of defence for margin requirements, and any additional exposure requires the member to bring additional capital or deposits. The Trap: Historical volume, client count and years of membership are not the criteria for exposure limits. Available capital and collateral determine the allowable exposure. Note: Distributor/cross-exam coaching labels removed; replaced with neutral wording.
